From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com, dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com

Subject: MAP draft & vendor onboarding checklist (post-call recap)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. I wanted to recap the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestones we discussed and share the first draft focused on the procurement/vendor onboarding milestone so we can keep momentum toward a September go-live for the pilot. Attached: MAP_v0.3.docx and our standard Vendor Onboarding Questionnaire.

Key vendor-onboarding milestones we discussed (draft):
- Ariba/Coupa supplier setup: Acme to create supplier profile or provide supplier portal onboarding info (Ariba preferred).
- Vendor forms: complete Vendor_Onboarding_Questionnaire.xlsx (tax details, contact, product catalog).
- W-9: Acme to provide completed W-9 (Acme_W-9.pdf).
- Banking/payment details: provide ACH details and remittance contact; Redwood to send vendor banking form if bank requires additional verification.
- PO and billing terms: agree on PO process and net-30 vs net-45.

Responsibilities (proposed):
- Acme: complete questionnaire, upload W-9, set up supplier record in Ariba/Coupa, share supplier ID.
- Redwood (Marissa/Finance): provide onboarding questionnaire, verify W-9, provide Redwood vendor form for banking (if needed), confirm tax classification.
- Redwood (Legal - Dylan): review any procurement terms or contract redlines that impact payment flows.

Dependencies / blockers:
- If Acme requires Redwood to register as a supplier (Ariba), that adds 3–5 business days after submission.
- W-9 + banking required before first invoice payment.

Target milestone dates (TBD):
- MAP milestone target close: 2026-09-10 (target for vendor onboarding complete so pilot procurement can issue first PO).

Next steps:
1) Elena: can you confirm the correct procurement contact and whether Ariba or Coupa is your preferred supplier portal?
2) I'll attach the questionnaire and a clean W-9 for your records — can you confirm receipt?
3) Camila, can you prep the Redwood vendor banking form and a brief PO/billing FAQ we can share with Acme?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Office: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments:
- MAP_v0.3.docx (draft MAP with milestone table)
- Vendor_Onboarding_Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet of procurement fields)

Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & vendor onboarding checklist (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap and draft. Quick answers and a few notes: 

- Procurement contact: procurement-team@acme.com (cc'd) is the best inbox; I will also loop Dan Rivera (SR. Procurement Ops) if we need supplier creation in Ariba.
- Portal: We use Ariba for strategic vendors; yes, supplier onboarding via Ariba is preferred. If Redwood needs to register as a supplier, Procurement will send an invite but we'll need completed forms and W-9 first.
- W-9: we can upload once we have the Vendor_Onboarding_Questionnaire completed. We requested a company-specific vendor form from our AP team that they require for banking verification — I'll attach if helpful.

Can you confirm what exact file/field names Acme should provide in Ariba? For example: Tax ID (EIN), legal business name, remittance email, ACH routing/account, and a copy of W-9.

Tentative timeline looks good; we aim to complete supplier creation within 5 business days after we receive the completed questionnaire + W-9. One ask from AP: will Redwood accept bank verification via micro-deposit, or do you require a bank letter?

Thanks — I will follow up after I confirm with Dan.

—Elena

Camila / Dylan — forwarding Acme's reply. Action items below: 

Camila (Sales Ops / Finance):
- Prepare Redwood vendor banking form and confirm whether we accept micro-deposit vs bank letter. If our standard is micro-deposit, note expected timeline for verification (2–3 business days).
- Fill out the Vendor_Onboarding_Questionnaire on behalf of Redwood where applicable and attach our W-9 (Acme asked for the file names they should upload).
- Draft a short PO/billing FAQ that explains Redwood's invoicing cadence, remittance email, and who to reach out to for AP issues.

Dylan (Legal):
- Do a quick check if there are any payment-related contract clauses that need to be flagged (e.g., passthrough fees, withholding, or international payment terms) before we finalize the MAP milestone. Likely low risk but want a quick sign-off.

Timeline: If we can get these items ready by EOD Mon (2026-08-30), we should be able to meet Acme's 5-business-day supplier creation window to hit the 2026-09-10 target.

Thanks — I’ll reply to Elena once we have the vendor form and W-9 attached.

-Marissa
